findings.detail: Three December 31, 2025 comparative-schedule positions were retained under report_date 2026-03-31.

rationale: The filing index identifies paired Schedules of Investments for March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025. The three flagged positions occur in the comparative schedule tables: Pace Common Stock at table 9 row 27, Pace HoldCo Term Loan at table 8 row 15, and TCW Strategic Ventures Common membership Interests at table 9 row 23. Retaining those earlier-period facts as March 31, 2026 position rows is a comparative-period leak. The affected cells are fully localized; no aggregate anchor is needed.
